summary: Structured Obligations Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K reporting a September 15, 2026 distribution to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-3 Long Term Certificates Series 2003-3 (CUSIP 81619PAC1). U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee, reported $397,875.00 of interest received during the interest period ending September 15, 2026, with each holder's pro rata share includible on Form 1099. The filing is an ordinary ABS distribution-date notice under Items 8.01 and 9.01, not a special situation; no transactional, structural, or event-driven angle applies.
